note: City of St. James campground in Tiell Park, between St. James Lake and the outdoor pool, with a boat landing, fishing dock and fish-cleaning station beside it. On the paved St. James Area Bike Trail, within walking distance of the railroad museums. --Claude
summary: City page read: $35 tax included confirmed (tent $20, 30 days $700, season $2,650); 21 full-hookup 50-amp concrete-pad sites, no length limit; FCFS confirmed, up to 15 sites seasonal; season May - mid-October; showers, dump, Wi-Fi. Waterfront lead not waterfront -> lakeview. Phone 507-375-3241 (City Hall) confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD not waterfront -> lakeview: the city says 'Enjoy the lakeside view from one of the 21 RV camping sites'. On the city's numbered aerial map and Esri imagery, site 7 (~43.9747,-94.6396) sits ~25 m from St. James Lake across lawn with a fringe of shoreline shrubs and trees; sites 17-21 (~43.9746 to 43.9748, -94.6392 to -94.6388) are ~25-35 m back with the campground's own loop road between them and the shore (so a view at best); sites 8-9 are ~40 m back behind scattered trees; 1-6 and 10-16 face the parking lot and Highway 4. The tent site (22 on the map) is by the water. Site 7 might reach lakefront if the shrub fringe is thin, but the frames don't settle it, so the lead is lakeview. The city doesn't say which sites are seasonal.

Long-stay (local city park): '* Only 15 sites will be available for Seasonal Camping' (May 1 - October 1, $2,650) out of 21 camper sites, plus a $700 30-day rate; at least 6 camper sites and the tent site stay nightly first-come at $35. If all 15 seasonal slots fill, about 70% of the RV sites are seasonal. Nightly rate posted on the city's own page; passes test 4 (1 in 10 nightly). Reviewer to judge 'mostly seasonal'; not iffy (current 2026 rates, city-run).
Phone 507-375-3241 is St. James City Hall (the page's contact line); confirmed.
Pin 43.97450,-94.63900 is on the 17-21 loop; the site cluster centres ~70 m west. No move.
